Perimeter geometry is irregular and non-geometric, with sharp step-function gradients from dark exterior pixels to high-luminance interior pixels. Most prominent structures are located in the lower-left and central regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse clusters of solid high-intensity white pixels localized primarily in the lower-left and bottom-center edges. These clusters lack an internal gradient and appear as compact, asymmetrical pixel islands.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle in the center-left field. A secondary linear alignment is formed by smaller high-intensity blobs along the lower-left boundary margin.
